summary: Specifies how a mobile node can move between networks and keep its IP address, with a home agent forwarding its traffic to wherever it currently is. This lets connections keep working as a device roams. It was replaced by RFC 3220.

eli5.summary: When you move house, the post office forwards your mail to the new place. Mobile IP forwards your internet packets to wherever you are now.

questions: how can a device keep its ip address while moving
